metadata.title: Villa Monte Calvia — Alghero
metadata.description: An elegant, warm villa in Alghero with a sprawling garden — perfect for families and groups seeking relaxation amid the nature of Sardinia.

home.heroHeadline: Your private retreat among the palms
home.heroHeadlineMobile: A private retreat among the palms
home.villaSubtitle: A private estate of approximately 1 hectare
home.villaDescription: Villa Monte Calvia is a private residence set on an expansive plot, surrounded by Mediterranean vegetation. It offers peace and space for slow-paced relaxation while remaining close to Alghero.
home.interiorsDescription: The interiors blend elegance with everyday comfort. You will find 6 bedrooms with bathrooms, a spacious living room with a kitchen area, and shared spaces ideal for rest.
home.gardenSubtitle: Covered veranda and relaxation areas amid greenery
home.gardenDescription: The garden is the heart of the estate: a covered veranda, a gazebo with a summer kitchen, and relaxation zones let you spend entire days outdoors. Evenings invite shared dinners and quiet moments among the greenery.
home.locationSubtitle: 15 minutes to the airport, beaches, and Alghero's old town
home.locationDescription: The villa guarantees tranquillity while offering quick access to central Alghero, the harbour, beaches, and the airport (approx. 15 minutes). It is the ideal starting point for exploring western Sardinia.
home.areaBedroomsDescription: Six spacious bedrooms with bathrooms — comfort and privacy for every guest.
home.areaSalonDescription: A bright, open living room with comfortable sofas and garden views — the heart of shared moments.
home.areaGardenDescription: A hectare of Mediterranean greenery, palm trees, and tranquillity — a private oasis of calm.
home.areaVerandaDescription: A covered veranda with a summer kitchen — cooking and relaxation in the open air.
home.ctaDescription: An ideal choice for families and groups of friends who value space, privacy, and the Mediterranean lifestyle.

villa.title: Monte Calvia
villa.description: Discover the interiors and surroundings of our estate — from comfortable bedrooms to the Mediterranean garden at the foot of Monte Calvia.
villa.salonSubtitle: Spacious living room with a fully equipped kitchen
villa.bedroom1Description: A spacious bedroom with a double bed and a bathroom. Air conditioning and WiFi ensure comfort throughout your stay.
villa.bedroom2Description: A bright bedroom with a double bed, bathroom, and garden views. Ideal for couples seeking peace.
villa.bedroom3Description: A comfortable bedroom with two single beds and a bathroom. A baby cot can be added on request.
villa.bedroom4Description: A bedroom with a double bed and bathroom. An extra bed for an additional guest is available on request.
villa.bedroom5Description: A cosy bedroom with a double bed and a bathroom. Air conditioning and WiFi come as standard.
villa.bedroom6Description: A bedroom with two single beds and a bathroom. The beds can be joined into one large bed.
villa.salonDescription: A spacious, bright living room with comfortable sofas and garden views — the heart of shared moments. The fully equipped kitchen with modern appliances lets you prepare meals in a homely atmosphere.
villa.gardenDescription: The entire estate lies at the foot of Monte Calvia, on approximately 1 hectare of land. Native Sardinian vegetation and exotic palm trees create a private oasis of calm. The whole area is fenced.
villa.relaxationZoneDescription: Dedicated relaxation areas with sun loungers and parasols — the perfect spot for a lazy afternoon with a book or a nap in the shade.
villa.verandaSubtitle: A covered space for shared meals
villa.verandaDescription: The covered veranda with a large table is the ideal place for shared breakfasts and dinners. In the evenings the terrace invites you to relax with a glass of wine overlooking the garden.
villa.sportsCourtSubtitle: Active leisure for the whole family
villa.sportsCourtDescription: A private court for team games — football, volleyball, and other outdoor fun. Ideal for families with children and groups of friends.
villa.summerKitchenDescription: A gazebo with a summer kitchen and barbecue lets you prepare meals outdoors. Sardinian evenings spent cooking together are an unforgettable experience.
villa.parkingDescription: A private car park on the estate grounds with space for several cars. Free and available throughout your stay.
villa.viewsDescription: The estate is surrounded by the quintessential Sardinian landscape — hills covered in maquis, palm trees, and a view of Monte Calvia. Nearby you will also find a nuraghe — an ancient Sardinian stone structure.
villa.ctaDescription: An ideal choice for families and groups of friends who value space, privacy, and the Mediterranean lifestyle.

privacy.title: Privacy & Cookie Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Privacy and cookie policy for Villa Monte Calvia website.
privacy.controllerBody: The data controller for this website is Villa Monte Calvia, operated at montecalvia.com. For any questions regarding data processing, please contact us at the email address provided in the Contact section below.
privacy.dataCollectedBody:
We collect the following categories of personal data:

— Contact form submissions: first name, email address, phone number, and the content of your enquiry.
— Analytics data: anonymous page-view statistics collected by Vercel Web Analytics (no cookies, no personally identifiable information).
— Marketing data: when you consent to marketing cookies, the FastTony pixel (Meta Pixel) may collect browsing behaviour data, IP address, and device information for advertising purposes.
privacy.purposeBody:
We process personal data for the following purposes:

— To respond to your enquiries (legal basis: legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
— To analyse website traffic and improve our services using Vercel Web Analytics (legal basis: legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). This tool does not use cookies and does not collect personally identifiable information.
— To deliver targeted advertising via the Meta Pixel / FastTony pixel (legal basis: your consent, Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). This data is only collected after you explicitly accept marketing cookies.
privacy.cookiesBody:
This website uses the following cookies:

— Essential storage: We store your cookie consent preference in your browser's local storage (key: "cookie-consent"). This is not a cookie and does not require consent.
— Marketing cookies: If you accept marketing cookies, the FastTony pixel (Meta Pixel) sets cookies to track your browsing activity across websites for advertising purposes. These cookies are set by Meta Platforms, Inc. and typically persist for up to 90 days.

Vercel Web Analytics does not use cookies.

You can change your cookie preference at any time via the "Cookie preferences" link in the website footer.
privacy.thirdPartiesBody:
When you consent to marketing cookies, data may be shared with:

— Meta Platforms, Inc. (via the FastTony pixel) for advertising campaign measurement and optimisation. Meta processes this data in accordance with its own privacy policy. Data may be transferred to the United States under Meta's data processing terms.
— Vercel Inc. processes anonymous analytics data on our behalf. Vercel Web Analytics is designed to be privacy-friendly and does not collect personally identifiable information.
privacy.retentionBody:
Contact form submissions are retained for as long as necessary to handle your enquiry and any follow-up correspondence, typically no longer than 12 months.

Analytics data collected by Vercel is aggregated and anonymous.

Marketing cookie data is retained by Meta in accordance with their data retention policies, typically up to 90 days after your last website visit.
privacy.rightsBody:
Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:

— Right of access: You can request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
— Right to rectification: You can ask us to correct inaccurate data.
— Right to erasure: You can ask us to delete your personal data.
— Right to data portability: You can request your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
— Right to object: You can object to the processing of your data based on legitimate interests.
— Right to withdraw consent: You can withdraw your marketing cookie consent at any time via the "Cookie preferences" link in the footer.
— Right to lodge a complaint: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority in the EU member state of your habitual residence.
privacy.contactBody: For any questions or requests regarding your personal data, please contact us via the contact form on our website or by email at info@montecalvia.com.

houseRules.title: House Rules & Rental Terms
houseRules.metaDescription: House rules and rental terms for Villa Monte Calvia in Alghero, Sardinia.
houseRules.reservationBody:
1. Reservations can be made:
— by phone: +39 320 717 1841
— by email: contact@montecalvia.com
— through authorised booking platforms (Booking.com, Airbnb). Prices on these platforms may differ and are binding.

2. A reservation is considered confirmed once the Guest has paid the required deposit within the specified deadline (detailed terms are sent by email in response to the booking enquiry).

3. Payment of the deposit is equivalent to acceptance of these House Rules.

4. Once the conditions in §1.2 are met, the Owner will send the Guest a booking confirmation.

5. Failure to pay within the required deadline results in automatic cancellation of the reservation without further notice from the Owner.

6. The Guest has the right to cancel and may do so in writing by sending a message to contact@montecalvia.com.

7. The amount paid by the Guest is refunded within 3 business days of receiving the written cancellation request, minus cancellation fees as follows:
a) free of charge — cancellation 45 or more days before the start of the stay
b) 50% of the booking value — cancellation 44 to 31 days before the start of the stay
c) 100% of the booking value — cancellation 30 days or fewer before the start of the stay
houseRules.checkInOutBody:
1. Check-in begins at 16:00 on the day of arrival; check-out is by 10:00 on the day of departure.

2. In special cases, alternative check-in/check-out times may be arranged with the Owner's prior consent.

3. Upon check-in the Guest is required to present a valid identity document and provide a list of all persons staying at the villa (max. 14 persons including children).

4. Persons not registered as guests may only visit the property with the Owner's prior approval.

5. The Guest may use the property solely for residential and leisure purposes and may not sublet it without the Owner's consent.

6. On the day of arrival the Guest receives the keys, which must be returned on the day of departure. A fee of €200 applies for lost or unreturned keys.

7. Any issues regarding the condition of the property must be reported upon check-in. Failure to report issues is treated as acceptance that the property was handed over in satisfactory condition.
houseRules.rentalScopeBody:
1. Rental offers and pricing are available on montecalvia.com and on authorised booking platforms.

2. The rental price is gross and covers the entire villa on an exclusive basis, including utilities, bed linen, and towels.

3. At least 3 days before arrival, the Guest pays a refundable security deposit of €500 by bank transfer. The deposit is returned within 3 business days of departure. Payment or non-payment of the deposit does not release the Guest from liability for damages exceeding the deposit amount.

4. The Owner is not liable for loss of or damage to items brought onto the property by the Guest.
houseRules.guestObligationsBody:
1. The Guest undertakes to respect good-neighbourly conduct and to maintain the property in its original condition. Any damage (including permanent stains, breakages, or missing items) must be reported to the Owner immediately. The Guest bears the cost of repairs or replacement.

2. Loud outdoor parties are strictly prohibited.

3. Quiet hours are from 22:00 to 07:00.

4. Visitors who are not registered guests may not enter the property without the Owner's consent.

5. Pets require prior written approval (email or SMS) from the Owner. An additional cleaning fee may apply. Unauthorised pets incur a charge of €100 per animal.

6. Smoking inside the villa is strictly forbidden. Smoking is permitted only in the garden and on the terrace.

7. When leaving the property, please ensure all windows and entrance doors are closed and locked.

8. Waste separation is mandatory — labelled bins are provided on the property.
houseRules.finalProvisionsBody:
1. The Owner reserves the right to carry out maintenance, cleaning, or necessary repairs during the Guest's stay, with prior notice, except in emergencies threatening life or property.

2. Italian law governs the relationship between the Owner and the Guest. Disputes shall be resolved amicably; failing that, the competent court shall be that of the Owner's place of business.

Please take care of the property, switch off unnecessary lights, turn off taps, and leave the villa in the condition in which you found it.

For the safety of our guests — the property is monitored by CCTV in common outdoor areas.
